mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 8.0% over the prior 3 months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 8.0% in 3 months, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth above 0.5% and industrial production growth above 0.3% over the prior 3 months indicate robust economic expansion, accelerating corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and INDPRO growth > 0.3% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and INDPRO growth exceed thresholds, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, CPIAUCSL rising above 225.0 signals inflationary pressures prompting monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above 225.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 750,000 units indicate strong residential demand, signaling consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 750,000, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 0.5% in one month signals labor market strength that increases disposable income and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% in 1 month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous real personal consumption growth above 0.3% and housing starts growth above 0.2% over the prior 3 months indicate accelerating consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.3% and HOUST growth > 0.2% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: When both RSAFS and HOUST growth exceed thresholds, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate increases above 0.25% signal reduced liquidity, increasing discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% in 1 month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
